snippet.title: BANCHOU TACTICS : LION HEART PS5 Trailer. Out Now!!
snippet.description:
Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart is a turn-based tactical RPG inspired by 1980s Japanese delinquent culture. Build your crew, master strategic battles, and fight your way to the top.

Out now on PlayStation5. @PlayStation  @PlayStationEurope
